source: Existing approved sheets only; native PIL cutouts/pixel geometry; ONE shared Duff transform rig,17 custom boss gestures.
verification: One consolidated scripted and visual pass, with local arm-cutout and cool-indigo rug-palette corrections.
runtime_limitations: Not tested in Godot. Single attack key pose, not a multi-frame attack animation. No timing, hitbox or projectile-anchor changes.
palette_correction: Crypto rug outline cooled from pink to blue-indigo to retain the existing magenta key without touching walk pixels.
local_corrections: Extended shared Duff arm cutout bounds to remove leftover hand pixels.
Retained bare Duff forearms on all short-sleeved/rolled outfits in attack frames.
Cooled Crypto rug highlights to keep the unchanged magenta key safe.
